title: On the relationship between block spaces and Orlicz spaces
summary: Let $1 -1$. Let $(X,d,μ)$ be an $s$-Ahlfors-regular quasi-metric measure space. Suppose that $B^{0,v}_q(X)$ is the block space which consists of all functions that admit a decomposition into $q$-blocks supported on balls. In this paper, we study the relationship between the block space $B^{0,v}_q(X)$ and the Orlicz-type space $L(\log^+\!\!L)^{1+v}(X)$. More precisely, we show that the block space $B_q^{0,v}(X)$ is a proper subspace of the Orlicz space $L(\log^+\!\!L)^{1+v}(X)$ for any fixed $1 -1$.
